nodes.claim: The paper suppresses the Euclidean reindexing and Gaussian covariance/block-diagonal product theorem needed to identify pi_{A_O} with the product of block Gaussians and the residual.
nodes.required_discharge: Use the actual contiguous coordinate map and sum-of-squares Euclidean structure. Ordinary Pi/product norm is not an isometry claim. Matrix inverse and coordinate compatibility must be established.

nodes.required_discharge: Prove precision/coordinate maps and Gaussian-family kernels measurable or suitably a.e. measurable; real product-prior map and actual bind must retain probability.

nodes.claim: Eq6 omits the derivation that integrating the fixed-block Gaussian product over independent common-sign matrices yields the product of single-block mixtures.
nodes.required_discharge: Finite product averaging with common fixed b and independent O_j; do not replace D or the mixture by the desired answer.

nodes.claim: Source omits the residual factor at r=0; signature retains a zero-dimensional Gaussian. Their equivalence needs the unique-point probability-space identification.
nodes.required_discharge: Residual measure is probability/Dirac on the zero vector, never zero measure. Erasing/reinserting this unit factor must preserve the joint-law interpretation.
